before_record.title: Exact size gate for complete balanced aggregation cost certificates
before_record.origin: Owner-directed Codex written argument and exact finite cost certificate
before_record.statement: For every conflict-free balanced family on 3N coordinates with N<=7, and every real n>0, each displayed budget B(n)=(n+1)^(3N)+sum_{k>=1}c_k*(n+1)^(3N-k), c_k>=0, satisfies B(n)>p*n^(9N/4). Distinct coordinate parts give p<=binom(3N,N); weighted AM-GM and exact integer comparisons prove the gap. The N=8 row is a non-exclusion control, so N>=8 is necessary only for this displayed budget to pass the direct 9/4 gate.
dependencies: External balanced conflict-free aggregation setup, Solomonik and Blaeser arXiv:2610.26563v2
Distinct-part injection argument and weighted AM-GM
Exact integer certificate for N=1 through 8
before_record.limitations: A limitation of the displayed rank upper-bound certificates, never a lower bound on actual tensor rank or omega. Does not exclude cheaper leading aggregates, other source identities, other target shapes, or different rank decompositions. N>=8 is not sufficient. No independent mathematical review or formalization.

after_record.title: Exact size gate for complete balanced aggregation cost certificates
after_record.origin: Owner-directed Codex written argument and exact finite cost certificate
after_record.statement: For every conflict-free balanced family on 3N coordinates with N<=10, and every real n>0, each displayed budget B(n)=(n+1)^(3N)+sum_{k>=1}c_k*(n+1)^(3N-k), c_k>=0, satisfies B(n)>p*n^(9N/4). With C=binom(3N,N), D=binom(2N,N), the full D-regular tripartition hypergraph has CD edges and selected parts induce exactly p. Deleting 3(C-p) vertices gives CD-p<=3(C-p)D, hence p<=floor(2CD/(3D-1)). Weighted AM-GM and exact integer comparisons prove the gap. The N=11 row is a non-exclusion control, so N>=11 is necessary only for this displayed budget to pass the direct 9/4 gate.

before_record.title: Explicit four- and five-split rank-76 Laurent seeds outside the closed standard-flip component
before_record.origin: Owner-directed OpenAI Codex continuation of an externally attributed factorization
before_record.statement: Two exact split variants of the pinned AlphaTensor M(4,5,5) algorithm have explicit rank-76 Laurent certificates. Four replacements at indices0,17,48,56 yield72 distinct U directions and a common discarded-arrow image flag vanishing at step9; five replacements at16,47,31,26,54 yield71 directions and a flag vanishing at step8. Both use unimodular physical bases and integer Laurent weights making every discarded factor entry positive. Complete contraction checks all10000 constant positions and no negative coefficients, with51 and172 positive remainder coefficients respectively. The original four-split certificate is retained unchanged.

before_record.title: Six simultaneous split deletions using positive tensor valuations and separate factor gauges
before_record.origin: Owner-directed OpenAI Codex continuation of an externally attributed factorization
before_record.statement: Six explicit U replacements in the pinned AlphaTensor M(4,5,5) algorithm give82 exact terms. Under the retained four-split unimodular physical bases and weights, the six discarded rank-one tensors have positive valuations3,3,6,4,1,3 even though two factors have valuation-2. The76 surviving Laurent terms have70 distinct U directions, exactly M(4,5,5) at all10000 constant positions, no negative coefficients and73 positive remainder coefficients. after_record.title: Reduction of arbitrary constant compression to a 46-dimensional outer space
after_record.statement: Over C, the certified 112-dimensional limiting space L of the specified two-sided A4 conjugation has the stated exact four-by-four outer block form. Every element of ordinary rank at most four is confined to block (3,0), whose matrix space E=G+[G,G00]+G00 G G00 has dimension 46 in Mat28. The kernel of any constant rank-110 long-leg compression is therefore exactly a compression kernel of E. A full M(10,10,11) target requires a rank-26 pair Phat, Chat with dim(Phat E Chat)<=37, equivalently a 26-dimensional U and two-dimensional W with dim{E in E:E(U) subset W}>=9.
dependencies: AI-A4-TWOSIDED-RANKLOSS-001
AI-RESOLVENT-SHARP-MINRANK-001 Section 2: every nonzero matrix in G+G00 G has rank at least six
Credited minimum nonzero source rank sixteen
112 exact block-coordinate identities, 16 exact transpose-conjugation identities, and elementary two-sided projection rank inequality
after_record.limitations: Necessary reduction for the one specified fixed conjugation family with constant full-rank long-map compressions. The universal reduced lower bound 38 is not proved, arbitrary constant compressions are not excluded, and satisfying the reduced condition is not sufficient for a full target. Same-session reasoning checks are not independent review. No formalization or exponent improvement.

after_record.title: Auxiliary border-rank margin from a generic channel-rank deficit
after_record.statement: For a complex formal degeneration S(t)+E(t)=M(l,h,r)+O(t) with E the locally mapped auxiliary R, suppose a d-dimensional first-covector subspace over C((t)), d>=1, has generic source channel rank at most rho<h. Then border_rank(R)>=d+h-rho-1, while the first-flattening bound remains d. Rank-one-term substitution leaves at most h-rho-1 surviving auxiliary terms; primitive normalization makes the total regular before determinant specialization. A border-rank approximation with parameter u may be substituted as u=t^N with N larger than the sum of local-map pole bounds. The paired corollary uses d=(l*r-n^2+g_B*g_C)_+ when positive and rho=a*b.
dependencies: AI-LAURENT-CHANNEL-SEPARATION-001 and AI-LAURENT-PAIRED-REPAIR-002, with unchanged proof and arithmetic files pinned
Established rank-one-term substitution method, attributed to Landsberg and Michalek, arXiv:1601.08229v1 Section5
Complex rank-one-curve characterization of border rank, attributed to Conner, Harper and Landsberg, arXiv:1911.07981v1 Section2.2; over a general field a formal rank-c approximation must be supplied
after_record.limitations: Requires d>=1 and the rank cap over the full Laurent field. For d=0 no bound is supplied. The added margin applies to tensor border rank, not the first matrix flattening. At fixed h the improvement is constant and supplies no near-full matrix construction or exponent gain. Same-session reasoning checks are not independent mathematical review or formalization.

after_record.title: All-field exact ranks and complete polynomial kernel for constant-endpoint quadratic-z source slices
after_record.statement: For every field K, integers a>=2 and b>=3, nonzero scalars alpha,gamma, and polynomial v(x) with degree below a (d=0 if v=0), the literal cyclic-source coefficient matrix for f(x,z)=alpha+z*v(x)+gamma*z^2 has rank ab+min(b,ceil(a/2)*d)+min(b,floor(a/2)*d). Its complete left kernel has the explicit basis from two central polynomial seeds with degree bounds b-ceil(a/2)*d and b-floor(a/2)*d. The formula is exact in every characteristic and for unequal a,b.
